# Anne Shirley & Matthew Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) — best of friends · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), +2 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to find [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) returned with a girl instead of the boy they requested. Devastated to learn she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay the night and puts her to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tentatively suggests keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help her, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) firmly insists she must be sent back.
>

Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the scenery from her window before being called down to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After a quiet meal with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps with chores while reflecting on her uncertain future. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly signals his desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on tidiness and is shocked to discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never said prayers before. After asking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pray in her own words, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hears [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliver an unconventional prayer expressing her desires and gratitude. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discusses Anne's spiritual ignorance with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and resolves to begin her religious education immediately.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P3](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her decorated church hat, she takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two girls quickly become best friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a treat of chocolates.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) calls [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inside for being late to her sewing work after talking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and bake a food basket for her. Over the following days, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bubbles with excitement about the event, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) worries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets her heart too much on things.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of attending the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes her mistake, and happily sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to enjoy the picnic after all.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the Sunday-school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by her wonderful day and shares the details with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughs heartily after finding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious because [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, getting her drunk. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to explain the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) refuses to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) or let [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) play with her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness to no avail, returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) heartbroken.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away at a political rally, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) because [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) has severe croup and her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her experience with past foster children to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. The doctor praises Anne's skill, and Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed and accidentally jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to leave.
>

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest confession and imaginative defense amuse Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), convincing her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become good friends throughout the rest of her visit.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home overjoyed after receiving an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Despite worrying about bad weather and etiquette, she has a wonderful afternoon and returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits to recount the entire visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) realizes that Anne's plain clothes set her apart from other girls, so he decides to buy her a fashionable dress for Christmas. After an awkward attempt to shop at Lawson's store, he gets Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a brown dress with puffed sleeves for her. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and she goes on to star in the successful evening concert.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Later, after a successful Christmas concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends perform, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing their accomplishments. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire expressing their pride in Anne's performance and considering her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has failed to prepare tea. Upon investigating upstairs, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green after purchasing a dye from a travelling peddler. After attempts to wash out the dye fail, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to cut Anne's hair off, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to take the mishap as a lesson in humility.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go, and Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) drives the girls into town where they stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). After enjoying days at the fair, a concert, and exploring the city, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are driven home, concluding that while city life was exciting, they are glad to be back.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who realizes how much she enjoyed Anne's company. After a pleasant drive back, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper as she recounts her trip.

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful summer before returning to her studies to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grows taller and quieter, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects emotionally on how fast she is growing up. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her changing perspective on life, language, and writing under Miss Stacy's guidance.
>

> After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the stage for an encore performance to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests at the concert. Afterwards, she dines with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, introduced to everyone by the pink lady, before [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives them home under the moonlight while they discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to begin her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) in town. After feeling lonely and homesick in her new boarding house room, she is visited by her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates and learns about the Avery scholarship, which sparks a new dream to attend Redmond College.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal at Queen's. After Commencement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and notices concerning signs about Matthew's and Marilla's health, as well as worries about their bank.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies from the shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and carry out Matthew's funeral with the support of neighbors. Afterwards, life slowly resumes at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to visit an eye specialist while chatting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about past memories.
>
